messages.subject: Tutorial on web services?
parts:
Hi All

I have a bunch of X-Y coordinates and I am trying to find the following information
(a) Median home prices in that location from Zillow
(b) Census Tract to which that X-Y location belongs to
(c) Population density, median income etc etc. from US Census 
(d) Some other similar information. 

As I understand it - this will involve making API calls to the relevant websites. I am looking for a tutorial / introductory material to help me get started. Would you know of any resources? I searched through DRUG discussions, but did not find any such discussions. 

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Tutorial on web services?
parts:
I would start with the vignettes in the httr package and links therein: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/httr/index.html. The jsonlite package also has a useful vignette.

Also, the CRAN Task views for Web Services and Open Data
(https://cran.r-project.org/web/views/WebTechnologies.html, https://github.com/ropensci/opendata) may have packages for the data sources you are using.
